title: X-Men '95 #1 Marvel 1995 Mister Sinister vs Apocalypse Terry Dodson Annual
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
X-Men '95 #1 (Marvel, October 1995), the 1995 X-Men annual. "The Heir to Apocalypse vs. Sinister", with Phoenix and the Beast caught in the middle. Written by J.M. DeMatteis and Ralph Macchio, art by Terry Dodson and John Paul Leon. Wraparound cover by Terry Dodson and Bob Farmer with foil logo. Direct Edition, $3.95 cover price.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
